anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: The Fernery Lodge & Chalets: Tsitsikamma Forest Sanctuary with Gorge Views & Gourmet Dining
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled deep within the lush Tsitsikamma Forest, The Fernery Lodge & Chalets offers a serene escape with breathtaking panoramic views of the river gorge. Experience luxurious chalets, an infinity pool that seemingly spills into the wilderness, and a fine dining restaurant serving exquisite cuisine. Perfect for nature lovers and couples seeking a tranquil retreat, the lodge provides a harmonious blend of comfort, adventure, and warm South African hospitality. Explore nearby forest trails, indulge in spa treatments, or simply relax and immerse yourself in the unparalleled natural beauty of the Garden Route.
